_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, margin, expense and receivables signals with Google's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Google is a global technology leader focused on improving the ways people connect with information.' 'We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising, and a reduction in spending by or loss of advertisers could seriously harm our business.' 'We face intense competition.' 'As our growth rate has slowed, the cyclicality and seasonality in our business has become more pronounced and caused our operating results to fluctuate.' 'In addition, expenditures by advertisers tend to be cyclical, reflecting overall economic conditions and budgeting and buying patterns.' (FY2013 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K says so of its own business ('the cyclicality and seasonality in our business'), the BKR, CAT and NVDA reading, not an industry's words; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a search and advertising company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services; CLOUD, live from 2012-10-30, is scoped to public cloud displacing on-premise IT, and this 10-K names the cloud only as Google's own products and services ('We now also offer infrastructure and cloud services to developers and businesses with Google Cloud Platform.'), so it is out of scope (the AVGO FY2012 and NVDA reading)), so the watch list is empty; the competition named is a competitive field, not a theme, and stays here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY04-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.7%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +42.5%/yr (FY04-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +158.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: GOOG (retrospective, 2014-12-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.22x (37.2% downside to Bear $329.77 / +166.8% upside to Bull $1401.40) | Adj composite 1.87 vs market 1.53: gap +0.34 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +53% above the EPP floor $342.47 (19x FY14E $18.02) | Conservative 2-yr case: +28.7% total (+14.3%/yr) | At 29.1x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $694.66 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +20.1% YoY in Q3 2014, forward revenues +20.1% (Q3 2014 revenue growth (no Q4 2014 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
